## [1.7.0](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0) (2026-11-13)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* correct app icon colors and show app icons in README ([da698b3](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/da698b30c6204ad53cdd68559258d25f6f564f29))

### ✨ New Features

* **devolutions:** add patches for Remote Desktop Manager 2026.3.1.5 ([128121c](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/128121c1ae46415be8075b44b3236275d9085845))
* **vtvgo:** add patches for VTVGo 12.11.05 ([8f49fe0](https://github.com/toidicakhia/morphe-app-patches/commit/8f49fe0a8e618e021892ee47e94661b43130c3a6))

patches.name: Unlock VIP
patches.description: Forces permanent professional VIP tier, removes ads and upgrade popups, bypasses PairIP.

patches.name: Unlock Plus
patches.description: Unlocks Universal Copy Plus: removes ads, upgrade prompts and the Internet permission, and bypasses the PairIP license check so the patched app starts.

patches.name: Disable Analytics / Telemetry
patches.description: Disables all Cloudflare telemetry by no-oping the analytics bundle builder and the Firebase event dispatchers.

patches.name: Disable SSL Pinning
patches.description: Bypasses OkHttp certificate pinning on Cloudflare API calls to allow TLS traffic inspection.

patches.name: Spoof WARP+ Unlimited UI
patches.description: Forces WarpPlusState to UNLIMITED on every AccountData instance by intercepting the primary constructor before the account type field is written.

patches.name: Disable Analytics / Telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance, including advertising-ID and app-set-ID collection. The Devolutions product telemetry is sent by the .NET code inside the AOT assemblies, use the app's "Disable sending analytics" option to turn it off.

patches.name: Disable SSL Pinning
patches.description: Bypasses the certificate validation of the .NET/Mono TLS stack so a debugging proxy can read the app's HTTPS traffic. Certificate pinning implemented in managed code lives in the ahead-of-time compiled .NET assemblies and is not affected. Not selected by default.

patches.name: Remove Ad ID Permissions
patches.description: Removes the advertising ID, Privacy Sandbox ad-services and Play install-referrer permissions.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Blocks feed, banner, interstitial, app-open and video player ads on every page except Benefits, where rewarded ads stay available.

patches.name: Bypass SSL pinning
patches.description: Bypasses EZVIZ certificate pinning and hostname checks so a debugging proxy can read its HTTPS traffic. Also trusts user-installed certificates. Not selected by default.

patches.name: Bypass Signature Check
patches.description: Skips the repack signature hash check in LoadingActivity that closes the app before it can start.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes banner, splash and hot open-screen ads.

apps.app_name: VTV Go - TV Mọi nơi, Mọi lúc

patches.name: Block Product Ad Banners
patches.description: Points the product-ad API endpoint at a non-existent path so in-app ad banners are not loaded. Best effort: ads embedded in content responses are not affected.

patches.name: Disable Analytics / Telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance, stops Sentry uploads and turns off Facebook app events. The firebase_data_collection_default_enabled flag also prevents the SDKs from re-enabling collection.

patches.name: Remove Ad ID Permissions
patches.description: Removes the advertising ID, Privacy Sandbox ad-services and Play install-referrer permissions. Device identification used for device management is left untouched.

patches.name: Remove Calendar Permissions
patches.description: Removes calendar read/write permissions. Programme reminders will no longer work.

patches.name: Remove Video Ads
patches.description: Removes VTVGo pre-roll, mid-roll, welcome TVC and other VAST/IMA ads by rejecting ad requests before playback starts.

patches.name: Trust User Certificates
patches.description: Adds user-installed CA certificates to the network security config so native traffic can be inspected with a debugging proxy. Flutter's Dart HTTP stack keeps its own trust store.
